newsitem.title: USA: Okla. Jan. tax collections up 8.7 pct over Jan.'96.
newsitem.headline: Okla. Jan. tax collections up 8.7 pct over Jan.'96.

text.p: Oklahoma's tax collections for January surpassed January 1996 figures as well as estimates for the month, a spokesman for the Oklahoma Office of State Finance said Wednesday.
General revenue fund receipts for January totaled $417.9 million, up $35.3 million, or 8.7 percent from January 1996, according to public information officer Harry Culver.
Collections came in $24.5 million, or 6.2 percent, above estimates for the month, he said.
Collections also surpassed last year's and were above expectations for the seven months of Oklahoma's fiscal year that have elapsed so far. Oklahoma's fiscal year begins July 1.

Collections totaled $2.172 billion during the seven-month period, an increase of $166 million, or 8.3 percent from the same period a year ago. The figure was $113.6 million, or 5.5 percent, above the estimate.
